items.note: Agent explicitly quantifies +6 m at 300 l/s and the anomalous K120-170 rising-main loss.
Agent generically proposes testing intermediate NRVs for a stuck valve, air or blockage, without concluding flow through the open DN250 bypass matches the system curve.
Agent predicts about 58 l/s dual-pump gain, substantially above the engineers' 15-20 l/s to about 280 l/s.
Agent links excessive pump/plinth vibration and cracking to short bearing and seal life and recommends plinth re-anchoring/rebuild, improved anchorage and motor support.
Agent links transient pressures to gasket failures and recommends tying/anchoring the manifold and joints and moving/replacing NRVs with low-slam types.
Agent proposes improved level and sequential-pump control but omits impeller change with IE3 motors and possible VSD removal.
